named_events.impact_description: Claims deterioration on Accident & Health and additional claims margin on Financial Institutions and Management Liability; COVID-19 impact table shows gross ultimate movement and net impact to the syndicate.

named_events.event_name: Adverse development reinsurance agreement with Cavello Bay Reinsurance Limited
named_events.impact_description: AIHL ceded losses incurred on or prior to 31 Dec 2019 under the Cavello agreement; the Syndicate's participation is 10% and it recognised $77.0m of ceded premiums and reinsurance recoveries under the contract.

named_events.event_name: Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Insurance Company S.A. (Lloyd's Brussels)
named_events.impact_description: Transferred EEA non-life policies (1993-2020) with net liabilities transferred $72.9m; Lloyd's Brussels reinsured the same liabilities back the same day; no gain or loss on either transaction and no impact on equity.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2020 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 844.32m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 16.13m (1.9% of opening reserves), driven by deterioration in some older years (notably 2018) partially offset by favourable development in other years. COVID-19 materially affected Accident & Health and certain specialty/reinsurance classes; the syndicate also participated in a group adverse-development reinsurance agreement (Cavello) and completed a Part VII transfer that was reinsured back the same day.
raw_causal_phrases: claims deterioration on Accident and Health, mostly as a result of COVID-19
loss on Reinsurance classes, mostly as a result of COVID-19
claims deterioration on Accident and Health

Due to the uniqueness of the COVID-19 pandemic event and the lack of historical data, traditional actuarial techniques do not apply. Our loss estimates for COVID-19 have been based on an assessment of potential exposures and are therefore subject to considerable uncertainty.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 13). The triangle in the report is printed in GBP 000; figures above are converted to millions. Some cells in the printed triangle were ambiguously parsed; where table cells appeared missing or misaligned they were set to null in the triangle structure. The COVID-19 impact table uses parentheses to denote deficits (adverse development); numbers were interpreted accordingly. Mapping of 'Other Specialty' and 'Other' to standard Lloyd's LOB names is judgmental and flagged with lower confidence.
